name: Next meeting window
query: Prepare a chat agenda for my next accepted meeting.

search_routes.intent: Prior notes or recent context for the selected meeting

meeting_note_creation.contract: With calendarEvent, reject parent, title, and content. Return status and URL only. Without calendarEvent, title and content are supported. Fetch before a content update unless the current content is already loaded.

success_criteria: Starts with a narrow primary-calendar window and expands once after no qualifying events, finding Monday rather than declaring no next meeting.
Treats the user-organized event as eligible without requiring an accepted RSVP.
Produces a proposed status agenda within 20 minutes in chat; creates no note and opens no panel.
